title: Longest Distinct Stretch
difficulty: Medium
position: 8
complexity: O(n)
=== statement
Find the length of the longest contiguous part of the array in which no number appears twice.
=== input
The first line has `n`. The second line has the `n` integers.
=== output
Print the length of the longest stretch.
=== constraints
1 <= n <= 131072
1 <= values <= 10^9
=== sample
8
3 1 4 1 5 9 2 6
--- expected
6
=== sample
5
2 2 2 2 2
--- expected
1
